frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button in the bottom-right corner that links to the business WhatsApp with a pre-filled message.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Dark blue footer with brand name, tagline, services list, contact details, social media icons, dynamic copyright year, and smooth-scroll anchor links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section for Bluefire CYSEC with a background image, dark overlay, headline, WhatsApp CTA button, stats grid, and smooth-scroll indicators targeting the pricing and next sections.
